name: x402-pay-per-use-extend-yarn
description: Yarn-only Hardhat-aware target validation after the How x402 Works extension. Named install allows fingerprint skip across attempts. Root yarn lint covers nextjs + hardhat. Docker/infra is allowed for this template but not required for gate 0–1 lint/build. Does not require facilitator keys or live settlement.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install Next.js and Hardhat workspaces with Yarn (pilot is yarn-only).

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: Lint the extended frontend and Hardhat workspace.
